name: nf-pipeline-1
label: the control pipeline: news-replay's Phase A configuration D-A (planner D, immediate entry A, the existing exits); experimental assumptions (author-selected), not a validated strategy
why: Master work order version 3, C1: 'the same tested pipeline (planner, AMT entries and exits as Phase B found best, or the control if AMT did not help)'. Phase B found no candidate. Entries: campaign 1's volume-profile entry (D-C) did not beat the price-only pullback (C6, p 0.9837) and every configuration's T was negative. Exits (campaign 2): the AMT acceptance and target exits beat the existing exits on news sessions (E1 and E2 Holm-significant, p 0.0003), but the price-only matched exit did as well as the AMT acceptance exit (E3, p 0.5591), so the gain came from leaving sooner, not from the volume profile; and every exit's T stayed below zero, so none qualifies (CAMPAIGN-2.md section 10). AMT timing as such did not help, and choosing the best-looking exit after seeing the results would be tuning on them, which needs a new recorded experiment. The forward account therefore runs the control: Phase A's D-A (planner D, immediate entry, the existing exits). It is not a candidate; it is the working system's forward test.
